تستحقروا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْقِرُوا (tastaḥqirū) /tas.taħ.qi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# تُسْتَحْقَرُوا (tustaḥqarū) /tus.taħ.qa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
